searchText: Yup I mostly agree with you. Though perhaps "just have a stateless eth client" is doing a lot of heavy lifting, with some subtlety in the implementation. Also maybe no one else is stepping up for putting that client into production yet? Portal or some other method is needed for da if we move to stateless clients since some will need to sync
